Sensitivity is evidence about these settings and this period. It does not establish that a strategy is robust to every future regime.

SAMPLING UNCERTAINTY

How much confidence does this path support?

A paired block bootstrap preserves short stretches of daily observations and compares the same resampled dates.

Intervals are conditional on the observed strategy paths. They do not include uncertainty from re-estimating or re-optimizing the model.

WHAT SITS BENEATH THE NUMBERS

Transparent by design.

These choices define what the dashboard can tell you.

01

Observed market history

Yahoo Finance adjusted ETF closes. Complete saved observations, no forward-filled price gaps, and 252 trading days per year.

02

Two views of risk

Full-history diagnostics use daily constant weights. Historical stress uses buy-and-hold window returns. Walk-forward holdings drift between decisions.

03

Decisions from prior data

Covariance is estimated before each held return. Configured historical stress windows ended before the walk-forward period began.
